test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: If 'A @ B' means 'A is the son of B', and 'A $ B' means ‘A is the sister of B', then which of the following expressions means 'M is K's sister's son'?
solution:
From the given information:

'A @ B' means 'A is the son of B'

'A $ B' means ‘A is the sister of B'

Now we consider each option and draw a tree to check the given condition using the symbols:

Option 1) G @ K $ M : G is the son of K, K is the sister of M

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a9f48f40d89d6339d3c1ba0baf179de0e2d8d52e2ca20160a5d7a9bc916b243.png] M is K's sister.

Option 2) K @ G $ M : K is the son of G, G is the sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952fa2c4cdc48f8b3ad952372dddd68947c82c0ac8cdbedd82ad12d8d85cc48a.png] M is K's mother's sister.

Option 3) M @ G $ K : M is the son of G, G is the sister of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8b1863270fa74cab0a41c7ea15577047f77f2c8c96c0007e65454eecc48f56f.png] M is K's sister's son.

Option 4) M $ G @ K : M is the sister of G, G is the son of K

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaddee437f4ec66900cbe941f9f0e3a77ccb68b9c8d6156f46a31a9574479905.png] M is K's son's sister.

Hence the correct answer is option 3.
